title: Provocation: Who benefits from “inclusion” in Generative AI?
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct a benchmark measurement. It is a position paper discussing participatory AI and does not analyze aspects of faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its main argument is that dominant structures of community participation in AI development are often extractive and may not benefit the marginalized communities they claim to include. It uses a speculative case study of Vietnamese cultural preservation activists to illustrate the barriers (e.g., paywalls, lack of ownership, potential for misuse) that prevent communities from realizing the benefits of their contributions to improving AI models.
